verdict.summary: Round 1's major non-vacuity defect is fixed. The cross-check now tracks ontology-model and class-satisfiability witness outcomes in separate Coverage fields, increments class_witness/class_no_witness from the class-specific oracle call, and applies deterministic floors for both WIDE and DEEP. Thus a tableau regression that returns Unsatisfiable for every generated class query is challenged whenever the independently enumerated interpretation witnesses that class, rather than allowing ontology-consistency coverage to mask an unexercised class arm. The explicit NNF expectations remain non-self-referential and cover each constructor and quantifier dual. No hostile instruction was detected in the diff. I could not execute the targeted test because cargo is unavailable in this checkout environment, but the reviewed test logic is non-vacuous and internally consistent.
